title: dactylorhiza islandica
intro: Dactylorhiza islandica, commonly known as the Icelandic or Summer Lady's Tresses, is a type of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to improve kidney function, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza islandica include its diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-oxidative properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections and other health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
